message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Official status:**  
> Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any Model S‑based variant) in India, so there is no published Indian price or availability schedule.

> **What that means for you:**  
> • If you’re looking for a price estimate, you can use the U.S. launch price as a baseline and then factor in the likely import duties, GST, and other taxes that would apply in India.  
> • The U.S. base price for a Model S (2024‑style) starts at **$90,000** (plus optional upgrades).  
> • At a rough exchange rate of **₹82 per $1** (the rate fluctuates), that translates to about **₹7.4 crore** before taxes.  
> • India’s import duty on electric vehicles is typically around **15 %** (plus a 5 % surcharge on the duty), and GST is **18 %** on the duty‑inclusive price. Adding those would push the final price to roughly **₹8.5–9 crore** (again, this is a very rough estimate and actual rates could differ).

> **Bottom line:**  
> Until Tesla announces an official launch in India, you won’t find a definitive price. If you’re interested in buying a Model S, you’d need to wait for an official Indian launch or consider importing it yourself (which involves its own set of costs and regulatory hurdles).
